description: Clinical transcriptions classified by the medical specialty they belong to.

labels.name: Cardiovascular / Pulmonary
labels.description: Heart, vasculature and lungs: catheterisation, echocardiography, respiratory failure.

labels.name: Orthopedic
labels.description: Bones, joints, ligaments and the musculoskeletal system, including arthroplasty and fracture repair.

labels.name: Radiology
labels.description: Imaging studies and their interpretation: MRI, CT, ultrasound, plain films.

labels.name: Gastroenterology
labels.description: Digestive tract, liver, biliary system and pancreas, including endoscopy and colonoscopy.

labels.name: Neurology
labels.description: Disorders of the brain, spinal cord, nerves and muscles, managed without surgery.

labels.name: Urology
labels.description: Urinary tract and the male reproductive system: stones, prostate, bladder.

labels.name: Obstetrics / Gynecology
labels.description: Pregnancy, childbirth and the female reproductive system.

labels.name: ENT - Otolaryngology
labels.description: Ear, nose, throat, head and neck: tonsillectomy, sinus surgery, hearing loss.

labels.name: Neurosurgery
labels.description: Operative treatment of the brain, spine and peripheral nerves.

labels.name: Hematology - Oncology
labels.description: Blood disorders and cancer: chemotherapy, staging, haematological malignancy.

labels.name: Ophthalmology
labels.description: The eye and visual system: cataract extraction, retinal disease, glaucoma.

labels.name: Nephrology
labels.description: Kidney function and disease, including dialysis and renal failure.
